decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered L-0009, L-0023, L-0010, L-0011, L-0012, L-0013, L-0020B, L-0021C, L0022A, Received 4 April 2011and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - The caf? and catering facilities shall not be open to members of the public and shall be ancillary to the use of the premises hereby approved by this permission and shall not be used as an independent commercial operation, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the building the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including the space for people with disabilities and six cycle spaces) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing number L-0023 and such spaces shall be permanently available and shall not be used for any other purpose.
description: Change of use from B8 (storage) with ancillary offices to mixed use building (Sui generis) including warehouse/storage (B8) with ancillary offices and sales (not to general public), food and catering, training and business support
